name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Either Needle goes with Tanner or Rowan goes with Mason.
Aldric, Potter, and Needle belong to different artisans.
Between Potter and Tanner, one goes with Loom and the other with Saw.
Exactly one of these is true: Aldric goes with Needle; Godfrey goes with Mason; Godfrey goes with Loom.
